name: Gabon
famous_for: Loango National Park ('Africa's Last Eden' with surfing hippos), pristine rainforests, and mandrills.
tourists: Approx. 190,000 visitors; famous for surfing hippos on Loango beaches and Ivindo Waterfalls.
must_know: Over 10% of Gabon's entire land territory is protected within 13 magnificent national parks.
fun_fact: Gabon's Atlantic beaches in Loango are one of the only places on Earth where wild forest elephants and hippos wander on ocean sands.
